digest.component_or_area: LLM model classes and configuration schema
propositions: rebar must express which model to use for each of three capability tiers (frontier, standard, trivial) via a three-slot config schema that supports model, provider, endpoint, and optional fallback arrays

the three tier slots must have per-class defaults (frontier=claude-opus-4-8, standard=claude-sonnet-4-6, trivial=claude-haiku-4-5) so that unconfigured deployments preserve byte-identical current behaviour

env vars must address slot fields individually (REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_MODEL, REBAR_LLM_FRONTIER_PROVIDER, etc.) rather than as objects, maintaining existing precedence (CLI > env > config file > default) on a per-field basis

fallback entries within a slot are non-recursive sub-objects carrying model, optional provider, optional endpoint, and forbidden api_key, and a nested fallback key within an entry must be rejected as a typed config error

the resolver must expose one entry point load_class_slots() in the new model_classes.py module that reads the real model_classes subtable from the merged [tool.rebar.llm] config and returns resolved class-to-provider-qualified-model mappings
secrets (api_key) must never be accepted as config file or slot fields, only via env, and must be loudly rejected if present in either a tier slot or a fallback entry
